messages:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] Sev2 — High GPU allocation failures in eu-west-1 affecting Dedicated pools. Partial degradation for customer Boxus. Symptoms: OOMs + preemptions, autoscaler errors. Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-345 

oncall-sam: I'm paged, joining bridge now. collecting logs and timeline.

sre-alex: Seeing lots of preemptions + OOM spikes around 15:00 UTC. Autoscaler appears to have entered cooldown and then hit quota errors when trying to scale back up.

infra-lee: Confirmed cloud quota rejects: "GPUS quota limit 0 for project/region: eu-west-1" — open quota request pending since last week but not approved. This blocked scale-up.

pm-maya: Any visibility into customer-facing errors? CS says Boxus is seeing 504s and long tail latencies.

support-jun: Boxus ticket #BOX-987 — they reported timeouts and 5+ second inference times. They're on-call and have been pinged.

sre-alex: Temporary mitigation: switched Boxus traffic to fallback model variant in west-2 at 15:02 UTC to keep throughput. Latency improved in tests.

oncall-sam: Steps I'm running: 1) confirm fallback routing, 2) evict non-prod workloads from eu-west-1, 3) open escalation to cloud quota team, 4) enable burst pool.

infra-lee: Eviction in progress — draining best-effort nodes now. Command used:
```bash
kubectl drain node/gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Currently evicted 4 non-prod pods, freeing ~32 GPUs.

eng-nina: Pushed an autoscaler hotfix PR to handle quota-rejection path and fall back to cross-AZ spinups: https://git.internal/r/redwood/autoscaler/pull/812 — tests passing in canary.

ops-ryan: Can we route new production traffic to west-2 while quota request is pending?

sre-alex: Yes, we updated routing policy to route eu-west-1 -> west-2 for Boxus only. Smoke tests show 95th percentile latency returning to baseline.

pm-maya: We should schedule a postmortem. Need RCA, customer impact summary, and owner list. I can coordinate with Boxus for a customer-facing summary.

oncall-sam: Propose postmortem: Tue 2026-02-10 16:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, root cause, mitigations, action items, customer comms. Anyone object?

support-jun: I'll notify Boxus and add incident notes to #BOX-987. Also escalate in their ticket that we've routed them to fallback and will schedule the postmortem.

infra-lee: Action: follow up with cloud accounts team on quota approval and tighten the quota request SLA. Owner: infra-lee. Due: EOD+2.

eng-nina: Action: merge autoscaler fix into stable branch, add unit test for quota-reject path, and roll to canary/stable. Owner: eng-nina. Due: EOD+3.

sre-alex: Action: add runbook step and alert for repeated preemptions + failed scale-ups so we page earlier. Owner: sre-alex. Due: EOD+1.

oncall-sam: Action: create dedicated dashboard and an alert for "quota-reject" errors that triggers paging when >3 in 5m. Owner: oncall-sam. Due: EOD+4.

pm-maya: Action: draft customer-facing incident summary and coordinate CS sign-off. Owner: pm-maya. Due: Before postmortem.

incidents-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-345. Postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-02-10T16:00:00Z. Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/INC-2026-345

support-jun: Boxus has acknowledged the fallback and asked to be notified before we backfill eu-west-1. Leaving a note on their ticket.

sre-alex: Backfill plan: after quota is approved and autoscaler fix is in stable we'll do a gradual canary backfill for Boxus traffic with health checks. Will coordinate window with support.

oncall-sam: Closing the bridge for now. Reopen if regressions appear. :thumbsup:
